amp-orange.$description: Amp Orange — Primary action fill, active step badge, accent rule, and brand strokes — the only chromatic color in the interface. Used at high contrast on white surfaces (7.0:1 against #ffffff) and as a warm border tint on cards and inputs

amp-glow.$description: Amp Glow — Orange supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

peach-wash.$description: Peach Wash — Soft highlight surface for featured cards and step accents. A near-gray peach that stays quiet while adding warmth to a card stack

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, logo mark, button text. 19.8:1 against white — the highest-contrast neutral in the stack

carbon.$description: Carbon — Secondary text and nav links, slightly softer than Ink. Icon strokes also draw from this level

slate.$description: Slate — Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated.

ash.$description: Ash — Disabled link text and placeholder-level text — the quietest text tone before disappearing

graphite-hairline.$description: Graphite Hairline — The dominant border color across the site — dividers, card borders, button outlines, and structural rules. By far the most-used neutral (1628+ borderColor occurrences)

fog.$description: Fog — Soft border for cards and body blocks where #e5e5e5 reads as too crisp against off-white

bone.$description: Bone — Neutral button fill (88 occurrences) — the ghost/secondary button background. A light step above canvas

canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Page background, card surfaces, button text on dark and orange fills. The base of the surface stack

linen.$description: Linen — Off-white alt surface — secondary button fills and surface tints where pure white is too clinical

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Dark elevated surface for cards, headers, and contained panels.

smoke.$description: Smoke — Heading underline accent in dark sections, heavier than Carbon

publicasans.$description: The only typeface in the system. Light 300 for display headlines, Regular 400 for body and UI, Medium 500 for buttons and emphasis. Tracking tightens with size: -0.036em at 72-78px, -0.030em at 48px, -0.020em at 32px, -0.010em at 16-18px, near-zero at body. The progressive tightening gives display sizes a magazine-cover feel while body text stays open and readable.
